page_title: BAR 2-0 RSO | Barcelona v Real Sociedad 13/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Guillermo Cuadra is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ilkay Gundogan trots off the pitch and is replaced by Oriol Romeu (Barcelona).
90+4' What was Raphinha (Barcelona) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
90+3' 2 - 0 Goal! Raphinha (Barcelona) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Alex Remiro into the bottom right corner.
90+3' Raphinha (Barcelona) is going to take the penalty!
90+2' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
90+2' The Barcelona players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!

90+1' Play continues despite the shouts by some Barcelona players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Guillermo Cuadra interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.

89' Barcelona slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
88' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Raphinha (Barcelona), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
86' A corner kick by Barcelona is thwarted by the well prepared Alex Remiro (Real Sociedad).
83' Real Sociedad are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
82' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Barcelona.
81' Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) sends in a direct shot from a dangerously positioned free kick. The ball sails towards the left post, but the goalkeeper prevents a goal with a quick save.
79' Substitution. Alvaro Odriozola (Real Sociedad) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Hamari Traore walks off.
79' Imanol Alguacil prepares a substitution. Brais Mendez is replaced by Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad).
79' A cross from Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.

77' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards the right side of the goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper with a stunning save.
76' Substitution. Ferran Torres (Barcelona) has come on for Robert Lewandowski.
76' The attendance is 35829.
75' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.

73' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the middle of the target, but Marc-Andre ter Stegen was alert and the score remains the same.
73' Kieran Tierney (Real Sociedad) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
70' Imanol Alguacil decides to make a substitution. Sheraldo Becker will be replaced by Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad).
70' Here comes a substitution. Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) is brought on as a substitute for Jon Aramburu.
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Kieran Tierney (Real Sociedad) replaces Jon Pacheco.
70' None of the Barcelona players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
70' Here is a change. Pedri is going off and Xavi gives the last tactical orders to Fermin Lopez (Barcelona).
70' We are about to witness a subsitution. Sergi Roberto (Barcelona) for Andreas Christensen.
69' Real Sociedad are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
67' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
67' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) easily beats an opponent inside the box and goes for goal, but his effort flies just wide of the right post.
66' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) sends the corner into the box, but Alex Remiro intercepts it and averts the threat.
65' A long pass finds Raphinha (Barcelona), and he decides to test the keeper from long range. The shot flies towards the top left corner, but Alex Remiro reacts well to make a good save.
64' Jon Pacheco (Real Sociedad) is booked.
61' The resulting set piece from Real Sociedad is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
61' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
59' Barcelona seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
57' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) has tested the patience of referee Guillermo Cuadra and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
55' A cross from a corner kick by Real Sociedad is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
54' A pass by Aritz Elustondo (Real Sociedad) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
53' Robin Le Normand (Real Sociedad) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
52' The game is interrupted now, Robin Le Normand (Real Sociedad) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
51' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) was quite harsh and Guillermo Cuadra didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
48' Raphinha (Barcelona) neatly controls a driven pass on the edge of the box, glances up and cracks a beautiful drive goalwards that sails just over the bar.
48' Barcelona have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
46' Barcelona enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
46' The ball is cleared after Raphinha (Barcelona) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' Guillermo Cuadra has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.

45' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
43' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) gets on the end of a pass and tries a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a wild attempt that goes well wide of the right post.
42' Barcelona seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
40' 1 - 0 Goal! Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) shows perfect technique and produces a first-time effort from just outside the box that goes into the bottom left corner. It's 1:0.
39' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
39' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) picks up a lucky rebound inside the box from the clearance, beats an opponent but drills his shot inches over the bar.

38' OFF THE POST! Raphinha (Barcelona) runs towards the goal to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the right post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
37' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 1:0.
36' Raphinha (Barcelona) latches on to a pass inside the box and strikes the ball to the middle of the goal, but one of the defending players makes a goal-line clearance.
34' A clumsy foul by Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) and Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle.

32' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Barcelona are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
29' Jon Pacheco (Real Sociedad) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
26' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) bursts past a couple of players and shoots from the edge of the box, but his shot is blocked.
25' Jon Pacheco (Real Sociedad) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for a foul.
24' Neat passing move from Barcelona in order to create new attacking opportunities.
23' A goal, which was scored by Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad), was disallowed due to offside.
21' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Raphinha (Barcelona).
20' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Guillermo Cuadra who sees an offensive foul.
19' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
17' Alex Remiro steps in and intercepts a long pass from Inigo Martinez (Barcelona).
17' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) offside.
15' A cross into the box from Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) is cleared.
14' Referee Guillermo Cuadra sees the trip by Andreas Christensen (Barcelona) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
12' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
11' The possession of the ball – 39:61.
10' Great teamplay by Real Sociedad as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
9' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for an infringement.
6' A long pass, executed by Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
5' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) commits a rough challenge and Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for an infringement.
5' CHANCE! Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) picks up a perfect pass inside the box, makes himself some space for a shot, but his effort goes just over the crossbar.
4' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle and signals a foul after Andreas Christensen (Barcelona) brought his opponent down.
3' Wonderful movement by Real Sociedad. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
2' Barcelona fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
2' Raphinha (Barcelona) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
1' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
